regime_cross_checks.ramp_quantile_method: numpy linear q90 over valid test turbine-target cells; FP64 subtraction of model-loader FP32 powers

statistics_protocol.seed_test: two-sided t test of five paired relative changes against zero; df=4
statistics_protocol.time_test: two-sided null-centered paired calendar-day block bootstrap of pooled seed-averaged normalized loss difference, variant minus full
statistics_protocol.bootstrap_rng: numpy default_rng PCG64; multinomial day counts; shared draws for all comparisons
statistics_protocol.bootstrap_p: (1 + sum(abs(centered bootstrap mean) >= abs(observed mean))) / (1 + valid resamples)
statistics_protocol.bootstrap_ci: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of uncentered pooled bootstrap means; descriptive unadjusted interval
statistics_protocol.bootstrap_weighting: ratio of resampled day sums to resampled target-cell counts, not equal mean of day means
statistics_protocol.sparse_rule: fewer than two occupied days: time p=1 and insufficient_nonempty_days; zero-denominator resamples omitted and counted
statistics_protocol.empty_bin_rule: retain all empty bins; p=1 in both complete BH families; metrics unavailable
statistics_protocol.bh: separate BH corrections for 252 seed tests and 252 time tests, metrics and bins pooled
statistics_protocol.relative_effect: mean of five values 100 * (variant metric / same-seed full metric - 1); positive favors full
statistics_protocol.clear_advantage: >=4 positive seed changes AND time q<0.05 AND mean relative change>=2%
statistics_protocol.clear_disadvantage: >=4 negative seed changes AND time q<0.05 AND mean relative change<=-2%
statistics_protocol.power_difference_precision: FP64 after reproducing raw-loader FP32 conversion
limitations: Day bootstrap measures conditional time variability after averaging five fitted seeds; it is not a hierarchical joint seed-time population test.
2000 resamples gives minimum corrected bootstrap p=1/2001; retain the requested finite resolution.
Overlapping history/forecast windows can span calendar-day boundaries; within-day dependence is clustered, longer dependence is not fully modeled.
Regime families overlap; these are conditional accuracy associations, not causal regime interactions.
No clear effect under these rules is not statistical equivalence.

current_text_checks.supplementary_seed_direction: Current S5 counts seeds favouring the VARIANT; Job A counts seeds favouring FULL. These signs are opposite.
current_text_checks.supplementary_test_scope: Current S5 tests overall errors; these tests cannot be reused for conditional regimes or for the relative-change t test.
current_text_checks.new_values: Regime analysis is new; no existing regime numbers in the exports to overwrite.

independent_numeric_review.method: Independent reviewer rebuilt raw masks and recomputed all seed rows without importing this analysis implementation; additionally sampled seven cross-family bootstrap comparisons.
